scene_description: A person with long hair stands at a large window holding a handbag, with a rolling suitcase beside them. An airplane is flying in the sky outside the window.

questions.question: What is flying in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up in the top right corner of the picture.

questions.question: What is next to the person on the ground?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is sitting on the floor near the person's feet.

questions.question: Who is standing at the window?
questions.evidence_hint: Look in the middle of the picture near the big window.

questions.question: What is the person holding in their hand?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person's arm and hand.

questions.question: Where is the person standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big glass wall in front of the person.
